name: jsudc
description: Universal Data Collection, all in TypeScript

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @jsudc/backend" "npm run dev -w @jsudc/frontend"
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:create -w @jsudc/backend && npm run db:migrate -w @jsudc/backend && npm run db:migrate:test -w @jsudc/backend
scripts.seed: npm run build -w @jsudc/core && npm run seed -w @jsudc/backend --
